summary: The open AI model ecosystem has grown enormously, with Hugging Face alone hosting over 3 million models as of early 2026 — though roughly half have fewer than 200 downloads, reflecting a long-tail distribution where a tiny fraction of models (the top 0.01%) capture the vast majority of usage. Alongside model hubs, a vibrant layer of developer-facing inference platforms (Replicate, Together AI, Fireworks AI, SiliconFlow, and others) has emerged to make serving open-weight models fast and affordable via simple APIs. These are distinct from enterprise aggregators (Bedrock, Azure OpenAI) and MLOps suites (SageMaker, Vertex AI), focusing instead on open access, rapid prototyping, and pay-as-you-go inference.

platforms.name: Hugging Face
platforms.purpose: The central open repository and community hub for AI models, datasets, and demos, plus hosted inference endpoints.
platforms.pricing: Free for public hosting and the serverless Inference API (rate-limited); Pro ~$9/mo; dedicated Inference Endpoints billed hourly by compute; Spaces hardware billed per hour.
features: Largest open model and dataset hub
Serverless Inference API and dedicated Inference Endpoints
Model cards, versioning, and community collaboration
platforms.best_for: Researchers, developers, and teams needing the broadest selection of open models, datasets, and collaborative ML tooling.

platforms.name: Ollama
platforms.purpose: Local-first tool for running open LLMs on your own machine (and increasingly on servers) with a simple CLI and API.
platforms.model_count: ~200+ curated models in the official library (many quantized variants)
platforms.pricing: Free and open-source; you pay only for your own hardware/compute.
features: One-command local model download and run
GGUF/quantized model support for consumer hardware
platforms.best_for: Developers and privacy-conscious users who want to run open models locally without cloud dependencies.

platforms.name: Replicate
platforms.purpose: Cloud platform for running and sharing open models (especially image, video, and audio generation) via API with minimal setup.
platforms.model_count: Thousands of community and official models
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-use billed by compute time (per-second GPU/CPU pricing); no minimums.
features: Run any model via a simple API call
Cog framework for packaging models into containers
Strong support for image/video/audio generation models
platforms.best_for: Developers and startups wanting to integrate generative media and custom models via API without managing infrastructure.

platforms.name: Together AI
platforms.purpose: High-performance inference and fine-tuning cloud for open-source LLMs and multimodal models with OpenAI-compatible APIs.
platforms.model_count: 200+ open models (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mixtral, FLUX, etc.)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token for inference (varies by model size); dedicated GPU endpoints and fine-tuning billed separately.
features: Broad catalog of leading open-weight models
platforms.best_for: Developers and companies building production apps on open LLMs who want speed, scale, and competitive token pricing.

platforms.name: Fireworks AI
platforms.purpose: Fast, cost-efficient inference platform for open-source and fine-tuned LLMs and multimodal models, optimized for production.
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token for serverless inference; dedicated deployments billed by GPU-hour; fine-tuning priced separately.
features: LoRA fine-tuning and custom model deployment
platforms.best_for: Engineering teams needing fast, scalable, production-grade inference for open and customized models.

platforms.name: SiliconFlow
platforms.purpose: Developer-focused inference cloud offering low-cost access to a wide range of open LLMs and generative models, popular in Asian markets.
platforms.model_count: 100+ open models (DeepSeek, Qwen, Llama, FLUX, etc.)
platforms.pricing: Competitive pay-per-token pricing; free tier/credits for popular models; dedicated deployments available.
features: Strong catalog of Chinese and global open models
Text, image, audio, and video generation support
Cost-optimized serving with free credits for select models
platforms.best_for: Cost-sensitive developers and those building on DeepSeek, Qwen, and other leading open models, especially in APAC.

platforms.name: Groq
platforms.purpose: Ultra-low-latency inference platform using custom LPU hardware to serve open LLMs at exceptionally high token throughput.
platforms.model_count: Dozens of curated open models (Llama, Mixtral, Qwen, Gemma, etc.)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token, with pricing emphasizing very high speed at competitive rates.
features: Custom LPU hardware for extreme inference speed
Very low latency and high tokens/second
Curated selection of popular open models
platforms.best_for: Developers building latency-critical, real-time applications on open models.

platforms.name: OpenRouter
platforms.purpose: Unified API gateway that routes requests across many open and proprietary model providers through a single endpoint.
platforms.model_count: 300+ models from dozens of providers (open and closed)
platforms.pricing: Pass-through per-token pricing per model plus a small markup; pay-as-you-go with credits.
features: Single OpenAI-compatible API for many providers
Automatic routing, fallback, and load balancing
Price and latency comparison across providers
Access to both open-weight and proprietary models
platforms.best_for: Developers who want flexible, provider-agnostic access to many models through one integration.
